WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.day_of_week, r.store_id, r.net_sales, r.net_sales_before_returns
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
    AND r.store_id < 900),
lfl AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM p1 GROUP BY store_id HAVING count(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2),
matched AS (
  SELECT fiscal_week, day_of_week FROM p1 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) cur_all,
    sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) pri_all,
    sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND (fiscal_week, day_of_week) IN (SELECT * FROM matched) THEN net_sales END) cur_m,
    sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND (fiscal_week, day_of_week) IN (SELECT * FROM matched) THEN net_sales END) pri_m,
    sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net_sales_before_returns END) cur_g,
    sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net_sales_before_returns END) pri_g,
    count(DISTINCT store_id) stores
  FROM p1 WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl))
